parsed.scene_description: A blurry warehouse interior filled with stacked wooden pallets and shelves holding cardboard boxes. Red machinery is partially visible. The motion blur suggests movement during capture, obscuring fine details. The floor is concrete, and walls are plain. No clear labels or markings are legible.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Stacked in rows on the floor and on shelves. Some are empty, others hold boxes. Located throughout the foreground and midground. Blurry due to motion. No visible supports or attachments beyond stacking.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Arranged neatly on upper shelves. Light brown with white labels. Positioned behind the pallets. Blurry from motion. No visible supports or attachments beyond shelf placement.

objects.label: red machinery
objects.observation: Partially visible on left and right sides of frame. Appears to be industrial equipment, possibly forklifts or conveyors. Blurry due to motion. No visible supports or attachments.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Metal racks with orange-painted beams holding boxes. Located in background and midground. Blurry from motion. No visible supports or attachments beyond structural integrity.
